outroLine: Map it once — every order after that is automatic.

beats.shot: Land on the PO Mapping tab: detected source columns on the left, ProcuLink fields on the right, wires between, auto-detect banner on top.
beats.vo: This is where ProcuLink learns to read a supplier's files. On the left, the columns found in a real sample file. On the right, the fields ProcuLink needs. The wires between them are the mapping — and most of it was matched automatically.

beats.shot: Cursor moves down the left column over detected fields and their sample values ('e.g. …'), then over a matched field's confidence.
beats.vo: Nothing here is a guess you have to take on faith. Each match shows its evidence — a sample value pulled straight from the file — so you can see why the wire is there.

beats.shot: Cursor moves to a mapped ProcuLink field card and rests on its 'change' control, then on the required-field marker. (No click — the matches are pre-accepted in mock mode, so 'Accept all' would flash 'Nothing new to accept'.)
beats.vo: And nothing is locked in. If a match is wrong, change it on the spot — every field carries its own change control, and the required fields are marked, so you always know what must be mapped before saving.

beats.shot: Cursor opens the 'Apply starter template' menu; the list (Generic CSV, Buyer Excel, cXML, Erply, Directo) is hovered, then the menu is closed without applying.
beats.vo: Starting from a known system instead? Starter templates pre-fill the whole layout. There are starters for Erply, Directo, generic C S V exports, and c X M L.

beats.shot: Cursor clicks 'Show standards'; standards references appear against the canonical fields.
beats.vo: And for the standards people. Any field can show exactly where it lands in U B L, EDIFACT, X 12 or c X M L. The mapping is not a black box.

beats.shot: Cursor moves to 'Save mapping' and rests on it (not clicked — the PUT has no mock twin; an on-camera click would error).
beats.vo: Save, and the mapping becomes part of this supplier's connection. Every order from them now parses the same way, automatically.
